cpuNotes.i9-13900K: A high-end 13th-generation desktop CPU with 24 cores and 32 threads, well suited to heavily threaded work.

gpuNotes.NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti: A high-end Blackwell desktop card with 16 GB of graphics memory, designed for demanding gaming and graphics work.
gpuNotes.NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080: A former flagship from NVIDIA’s Pascal generation, with 8 GB of graphics memory. It can still handle lighter games, while demanding newer titles may need lower settings.
